title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Joshua 6: the march around Jericho, the fall of its walls, and the rescue of Rahab.

questions.text: What was the situation in Jericho at the start of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel; no one went out and no one came in.

answers.text: Its gates stood open to traders
Its people had already abandoned it
It was tightly shut up, and no one went out or came in
It had just been burned by the Amorites

questions.text: How often were the men of war to march around the city on each of the first six days?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Joshua that the men of war should go around the city once, and do this for six days.

questions.text: What were the seven priests to carry before the ark?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that seven priests should bear seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark.

questions.text: What did Joshua command the people about their voices while they marched?
questions.explanation: Joshua told the people not to shout or let their voice be heard, and not to say a word, until the day he told them to shout.

answers.text: To sing praises as they marched
Not to shout or say a word until he told them to
To call out to the people of Jericho

questions.text: How many times did they march around the city on the seventh day?
questions.explanation: On the seventh day they rose early at dawn and marched around the city seven times.

questions.text: Who alone in Jericho was to be kept alive?
questions.explanation: Joshua said only Rahab the prostitute should live, she and all who were with her in the house, because she hid the messengers.

answers.text: The king of Jericho and his household
The mighty men of valor in the city
Rahab and all who were with her in her house
The elders and priests of the city

questions.text: Where were the silver, gold, and vessels of bronze and iron to go?
questions.explanation: Joshua said these were holy to Yahweh and would come into Yahweh's treasury.

answers.text: To the men who captured them
Into the fire with the city
Into a pit outside the camp

questions.text: What happened when the people shouted with a great shout?
questions.explanation: When the people shouted with a great shout, the wall fell down flat and the people went up into the city.

answers.text: The king came out and surrendered
Fire came down from the sky

questions.text: Who went into the house and brought Rahab out?
questions.explanation: The young men who were spies went in and brought out Rahab with her father, mother, brothers, and all that she had.

answers.text: The young men who had been spies

questions.text: According to Joshua's oath, what would the man who lays Jericho's foundation lose?
questions.explanation: Joshua said that the man who rises up and builds Jericho would lay its foundation with the loss of his firstborn.
